title.ja: イケメンすぎて逮捕！？エフェクトで遊ぶジャンとクリッティン！
title.en: Arrested for Being Too Handsome!? Jang and Krittin Play with Filters!
title.ko: 너무 잘생겨서 체포!? 필터로 노는 장과 크릿틴!
title.zh-TW: 太帥而被逮捕！？Jang和Krittin玩特效濾鏡！
title.id: Ditangkap karena Terlalu Tampan!? Jang dan Krittin Bermain dengan Filter!
title.pt: Preso por ser bonito demais!? Jang e Krittin brincando com filtros!

summary.ja: ジャンとクリッティンがTikTokのランダム罪名フィルターに挑戦。「通報レベルのイケメン罪」という結果に満足そうな表情を見せる仲良し動画です。
summary.en: Jang and Krittin try out TikTok's random crime filter. A heartwarming video of close friends looking pleased with the result: 'Guilty of being handsome enough to report to the police!'
summary.ko: 장과 크릿틴이 TikTok의 랜덤 죄명 필터에 도전합니다. '신고각 잘생김 죄'라는 결과에 만족스러운 표정을 짓는 절친 케미 영상입니다.
summary.zh-TW: Jang和Krittin挑戰TikTok的隨機罪名濾鏡。看到「帥到差點報警罪」的結果時露出滿意表情的感情超好影片。
summary.id: Jang dan Krittin mencoba filter tuduhan acak di TikTok. Video kedekatan mereka yang tampak puas dengan hasil 'Bersalah karena terlalu tampan sampai hampir lapor polisi'.
summary.pt: Jang e Krittin experimentam o filtro de crime aleatório do TikTok. Um vídeo de amigos próximos parecendo satisfeitos com o resultado: 'Culpado por ser tão bonito a ponto de quase chamar a polícia'.

caption.th:
คุณจะโดน จับ ข้อหา...
มองนิต เกินกำหนด
ไม่สิ้มคนน่ารัก
ยิ้มหวาน เกิน 120
สวย ซะจน หมาหอน
แน่น โดยไม่ได้รับอนุญาต
หล่อ จนเกือบ แจ้งความ
caption.ja:
あなたは〜の罪で逮捕されます...
視線注ぎすぎ罪
可愛さに耐えられない罪
甘い笑顔120オーバー罪
犬も遠吠えするほど美しい罪
許可なき魅力溢れすぎ罪
通報レベルのイケメン罪
caption.en:
You will be arrested for the crime of...
Staring too much
Unable to resist cuteness
Sweet smile exceeding 120
So beautiful that dogs howl
Tightly packed charm without permission
Almost handsome enough to call the police
caption.ko:
당신은 ~의 죄로 체포됩니다...
너무 오래 쳐다본 죄
귀여움을 참지 못한 죄
달콤한 미소 시속 120km 초과 죄
개도 울부짖을 만큼 아름다운 죄
허가 없이 매력이 넘친 죄
경찰에 신고할 뻔한 잘생김 죄
caption.zh-TW:
你將會因……罪名被逮捕：
盯著看超時罪
無法抗拒可愛罪
甜美笑容超速120罪
美到讓狗都嚎叫罪
未經許可魅力滿溢罪
帥到差點報警罪
caption.id:
Kamu akan ditangkap atas tuduhan...
Menatap terlalu lama
Tak tahan melihat orang imut
Senyum manis melebihi 120
Sangat cantik sampai anjing melolong
Terlalu menarik tanpa izin
Sangat tampan sampai hampir lapor polisi
caption.pt:
Você será preso pela acusação de...
Olhar fixamente além do limite
Não resistir a pessoas fofas
Sorriso doce passando de 120
Tão linda que até os cachorros uivam
Cheio de charme sem permissão
Tão bonito a ponto de quase chamar a polícia
